answers.(b): $1120 is 8 × $140, i.e. simple interest on the original $5600 only. With compound interest each year's interest is worked out on the previous year's amount, which is larger every year (e.g. year 2 earns $143.50, not $140), so the yearly interest keeps increasing and the 8-year total (about $1223.05) is more than $1120.
